question_text: A research team develops a new monoclonal antibody checkpoint inhibitor for advanced melanoma that has shown promise in animal studies as well as high efficacy and low toxicity in early phase human clinical trials. The research team would now like to compare this drug to existing standard of care immunotherapy for advanced melanoma. Because the novel drug has been determined to have few side effects, this trial will offer the novel drug to patients who are deemed to be at risk for toxicity with the current standard of care immunotherapy. Which of the following best describes the level of evidence that this study can offer?
